name: Fadhil Khalid
headline: Business Operations Architect | Business & Information Architecture | Operational Systems
masterStatement: I make complex organisations easier to understand by connecting how work actually happens with the information, decisions and systems that sustain it.
summary: Business Operations Architect with an engineering foundation, working across business architecture, information architecture, operational intelligence and digital systems. I begin by discovering how work actually happens—not only through documented processes and formal systems, but also through the informal information flows, handoffs, decisions and dependencies that keep an organisation moving. I trace how people, processes and information connect; reconcile definitions, relationships and ownership; and design practical systems that make critical operations more visible, coherent and sustainable. I combine data modelling and integration with hands-on workflow, automation and application design, evolving existing systems through controlled changes that consider data quality, compatibility and downstream impact.

principles.title: Discover how the organisation really works
principles.text: Look beyond organisation charts and documented procedures. Understand the people, routines, informal workarounds and dependencies that sustain day-to-day outcomes.

principles.title: Make critical flows visible
principles.text: Trace how information, decisions and work move across teams. Identify where knowledge sits, where handoffs break down and which dependencies remain hidden.

principles.title: Create shared meaning without erasing ownership
principles.text: Reconcile definitions, relationships and responsibilities so teams can work from a coherent view while accountable functions retain their decision rights.

principles.title: Design for sustainable operation
principles.text: Turn validated understanding into appropriate process, information and technology structures that preserve what works, reduce fragility and support continuous improvement.
